verdict.rationale: Sift's docs list abuse products beyond checkout, each with its own score in one platform: Account Takeover, Account Abuse (fake accounts), and Promotion Abuse (referral rings, repeated promo use). Abuse-specific scores, Workflows, Review Queues and Decisions (e.g., Ban Account) manage these types together in the same system. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the non-checkout abuse scoring and management work in practice (all evidence is vendor documentation).

support.subject: As a risk analyst, protection extends beyond checkout — account takeover, fake account creation, promo and policy abuse are scored and managed in the same system

citations.quote: Account Takeover - Stop fraudulent actors from hijacking users accounts.
Account Abuse - Stop fake accounts from polluting your service and block fraudulent users before they harm your business.
Promotion Abuse - Make sure you're only rewarding real users by stopping referral rings and repeated use of promotions.
Want to fight multiple types of fraud at once? Learn how to add an abuse-specific risk score so that you can easily do so.
Sift offers Workflows, a powerful rules automation platform, and Review Queues.
Learn to set up custom Decisions, like Ban Account or Cancel Order, that are connected to real business actions in your backend.
